headlines.title: Grand Canyon Flash Floods Leave 1 Dead, 15 Potentially Missing
headlines.description: A desperate search for missing tourists is underway after dangerous flash floods swept through the Grand Canyon. At least one person was killed and more than a dozen others are still unaccounted for. NBC’s Dana Griffin reports and TODAY’s Dylan Dreyer tracks another round of thunderstorms that could lead to new flooding.

headlines.title: Rescuers Struggle to Reach Areas Devastated by Nepal Floods
headlines.description: Rescue efforts are also intensifying in Nepal and Tibet where thousands remain missing, including dozens of Americans, nearly a week after catastrophic floods there. Workers are struggling to reach communities devastated by the flood, including hundreds of workers trapped inside hydropower tunnels. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: US Forces Strike Iranian Missile Launchers Near Strait of Hormuz
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are trading attacks for the first time in weeks, just days after the war reached the six-month mark. US CENTCOM says it struck Larak Island where missile launchers were preparing to deploy mines into the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Matt Bradley reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: House returns from five weeks away with a top priority: Avoid a government shutdown
headlines.description: The House is back ith a top priority of avoiding a government shutdown before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Bootleg ‘Spider-Man’ swings into Russian cinemas despite Hollywood boycott
headlines.description: While screening the movie “violates both Russian and international law,” everyone, including Russian authorities, “turns a blind eye to it,” one film critic told NBC News.

headlines.title: Death toll in Nepal floods tops 900, number of missing nearly doubles to more than 4,200
headlines.description: More than 900 people were killed by the devastating flooding in Nepal, officials in the south Asian country said Monday as the number of those listed as missing almost doubled to 4,247, including 592 foreign nationals.
